text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Workers' union leaders to meet cabinet ministers over wages and salary arrears.
- The Transitional National Council passes into law a proportional representation voting system.
- Algeria increases tax collection by 59 percent to 36.7 billion dinars ($655 million) in 1996 from 23 billion dinars in 1995.
- Legal Islamist parties, Nahda and Hamas, consider their electoral coalition in the parliamentary poll planned for the first half of this year. ($1 = 56 dinars)
